lines: The Golden Scarab has released a public complaint about the Spoilage, painted on the walls of Redwall Street.
They are once again here to complain about the Spoilage.
The complaint was transcribed in today's Partine Daily.
The long and short of it—they believe Our Lady isn't working hard enough to find a cure.
We have already enlisted foreign aid to support our country, so that our leading doctors can focus on a remedy. Though we haven't enlisted any foreign doctors…
And risk that terrible disease spreading elsewhere? No thanks.
As much as I feel for the quarantined Verehnians, I'd rather we keep the disease contained and cure it. Our Lady made the right move.
As for the Golden Scarab… I feel for them too. People across Aijinkova have been quarantined in that city for years. But lifting it wouldn't be right.
It seems the Golden Scarab wasn't referring to the quarantine itself, but rather the search for a cure.
Leading Spoilage researcher and acclaimed head doctor Professor Octavian seems to have abandoned his post, last seen covered head to toe, donning a helmet in the shape of a bird's head.
Our Lady has not put out a public statement for a replacement. And they… ahem. Think she isn't taking the plague seriously.
